## 简体中文

### 亮点

- Sempre 迎来首个稳定版 1.0，新增跟随所选核心及其能力的核心专属推荐订阅配置。
- 订阅编辑立即保存为草稿，不拉取来源、不编译运行配置，也不中断托管核心；运行启动或重启时原子校验并暂存最新修订。
- 提供托管 GEO 规则集设置，涵盖中国大陆域名、中国大陆 IP、可选排除香港、来源 URL 和下载 detour。

### 修复

- 防止 Bitwarden 将本地代理凭据和管理 API 密钥识别为网站登录信息，消除离开运行设置后的重复密码保存提示。
- 托管核心退出时保留预期的停止中过渡状态，不再短暂把旧 PID 报告为运行失败。
- 隔离 Linux 专属 DNS 测试、让自动配置 fixture 与平台无关、保留 Windows 便携安装器检查，并在三大平台验证原生服务生命周期和管理 API，恢复 Windows、macOS、Linux 发布门禁。

### 安全与发布工程

- 使用 Go 1.25.13 构建发布产物，修复 Go 1.25.12 中扫描到的可达标准库安全问题。
- 通过完整 Go 测试、vet、竞态检测、前端测试、lint、类型检查、跨平台原生服务冒烟测试、产物校验和、构建来源证明和各目标 SBOM 验证本版本。

- [完整更新记录](https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v0.6.0...v1.0.0)

## English

### Highlights

- Promote Sempre to its first stable 1.0 release with core-specific recommended subscription configurations that follow the selected core and its capabilities.
- Save subscription edits immediately as drafts without fetching sources, compiling runtime configuration, or interrupting the managed core; validate and stage the latest revision atomically when the runtime starts or restarts.
- Expose managed GEO rule-set settings for CN domains, CN IPs, optional HK exclusion, source URLs, and download detours.

### Fixes

- Prevent Bitwarden from treating local proxy credentials and management API secrets as website logins, eliminating repeated password-save prompts after leaving Runtime settings.
- Preserve the expected stopping transition when the managed core exits, instead of briefly reporting a stale PID as a runtime failure.
- Restore Windows, macOS, and Linux release gates by isolating Linux-only DNS tests, making automatic-configuration fixtures platform independent, preserving portable installer checks on Windows, and validating native-service lifecycle and management API behavior on all three platforms.

### Security and release engineering

- Build release artifacts with Go 1.25.13, addressing the reachable standard-library advisories detected with Go 1.25.12.
- Validate the release with full Go tests, vet, race detection, frontend tests, linting, type checking, cross-platform native-service smoke tests, artifact checksums, build provenance attestations, and per-target SBOMs.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v0.6.0...v1.0.0
